runs.text: 1. Why are underscores used in numeric literals in Java?
Underscores can be placed inside numeric literals to improve readability. They do not change the actual value.
2. How many underscores can be used between digits in a numeric literal?
Java allows any number of underscores between digits.
3. Can an underscore be placed at the beginning or end of a numeric literal?
No. An underscore cannot be placed before the first digit or after the last digit.
An underscore must be placed only between digits.
